description: Get a transaction's status, parties, fee and every ERC-20 transfer inside it, decoded. A Base transaction by hash: status, block, from, to, value, fee, method, and every ERC-20 transfer inside it decoded with symbol and human amount. Query: ?hash=0x… — $0.005000/call, paid per request via x402 (USDC). Use when asked: "did this transaction succeed", "transaction receipt on base", "decode this tx hash".
name: chain_tx
